name: Astranaar
summary: Astranaar holds the Night Elves’ ground in central Ashenvale, across an island in the forest lake. The ancient forest road runs beside it, and Alliance travelers find refuge there as furbolgs, satyrs, and the Horde threaten the region.

sections.title: Heart of the Forest
sections.body: Wooden footbridges link Astranaar’s island to the mainland, crossing the forest lake. It is Ashenvale’s largest night elven settlement, where sentinels, priests, and artisans keep watch over the woodlands. Travelers find an inn, traders, and an expert leatherworker. On the high perches, a flight master sends hippogryphs to distant outposts across Kalimdor.

sections.title: A Bastion Under Siege
sections.body: Lanterns glow over Astranaar’s tranquil waters, but the town stays ready for attack. Raene Wolfrunner and other local leaders coordinate patrols and defenses against the corrupted Thistlefur furbolgs advancing from the north. The Sentinels fear the furbolgs may assault the settlement.

faq.q: What services are available in Astranaar?
faq.answer: Astranaar has an inn, general goods vendors, an expert leatherworking trainer, and a flight master with routes to key outposts across Ashenvale and Kalimdor.

faq.q: Who is buried in the graveyard across the lake?
faq.answer: No account from this era names who rests in the cemetery across the lake from Astranaar. Its graves keep their secrets.

faq.q: Why are the Sentinels in Astranaar worried about the local furbolgs?
faq.answer: The Thistlefur furbolgs to the north have fallen under dark, corrupting influences. Sentinel Raene Wolfrunner fears their growing aggression may lead them to attack Astranaar.

faq.q: Can Horde players visit Astranaar safely?
faq.answer: No. Armed Night Elf Sentinels guard Astranaar, a fortified Alliance stronghold, and attack Horde members on sight.

angles.text: For the Kaldorei, Astranaar guards their ancient homeland in central Kalimdor and its sacred groves against growing threats in the forest.
For the Alliance, Astranaar is a command post and logistical hub in Ashenvale’s contested wilderness.
